liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin'** (2 reviews): The twenty-minute performance of this song is highlighted as an excellent moment; This song is described as rocking, while the rest of the night kicks [5][15]
- **I Second That Emotion** (1 review): This song is identified as a rare treat within the recording [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Second That Emotion**: rare: 7 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-13.sbd.unknown.32015.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 123 min; rated 4.5/5 by 24 [1]. Said about its sound: The recordings are characterized as clear and rich; The sound quality of the recording is rated as excellent [12][15]
- **gd1971-04-13.sbd.bertha-ashley.32077.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 123 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: High end was bright and tinny due to a strange upward frequency slope [2]
- **gd71-04-13.s2p.9410.eliot.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 51 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as having good quality; The recording is plagued by distortion and bad sound quality [5][10]
- **gd1971-04-13.sbd.ashley.82986.dvdf**: soundboard; 0 songs; 0 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Pig Pen was noted to be in good form during this period [7]
- The reviewer suggests the old CYO hall should become a shrine [8]
- New Riders opened, Garcia played steel, and the band dedicated a song to Janis [9]
- The reviewer hitchhiked to the venue, sat in the fourth row, and rode on the band's bus [9]
- The Catholic Youth Center venue was described as hopping on this night [12]
- Pig Pen gave extra effort for the good Catholic girls in attendance [15]
- The reviewer asks about the April 28, 1971 show, which they consider superior [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-13.sbd.unknown.32015.sbeok.flacf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: A few seconds are missing at the start of four specific songs; The upload is identified as the complete show [1]
- **gd1971-04-13.sbd.bertha-ashley.32077.sbeok.flac16**: source: Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel source (shn ID 32015) [2]. Also: Digitally remastered in January 2006 using a custom dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha [2]
- **gd71-04-13.s2p.9410.eliot.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by jools; source: Soundboard Partial - Set 2 Only [3]
- **gd1971-04-13.sbd.ashley.82986.dvdf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>FLAC>>DAW(Bertha)>>Audio DVD [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1971-04-13 Catholic Youth Center, Scranton, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1971-04-13-catholic-youth-center-scranton-pa-usa/) [18]
- Poster by Edward Goralewski: [Time Warp – The Dead live it up at Montage Mountain](https://www.thetimes-tribune.com/2020/06/23/time-warp-the-dead-live-it-up-at-montage-mountain-2/) [19]
- Fan art by www.bahrgallery.com: [Scranton Catholic Youth Center, 1971 - Band - Items - Bahr Gallery](https://www.bahrgallery.com/band-items/scranton-catholic-youth-center-1971) [20]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 51: Scranton Catholic Youth Center, Scranton, PA (4/](https://store.dead.net/products/daves-picks-vol-51-scranton-catholic-youth-center-scranton-pa-4-13-71?variant=42469380292650) [21]
